description:
DuyNgSkeleton is a unique art brand specializing in Real Skeleton Taxidermy Art. Our creations transform ethically sourced animal remains into exquisite works of art, celebrating the beauty of natural history and gothic aesthetics.

Product Description:

Each piece is meticulously handcrafted, ensuring every detail highlights the natural elegance of bones. Our collection includes skeletal sculptures, bone-based home decor, and custom artistic pieces designed for collectors, gothic enthusiasts, and lovers of the macabre.

Authenticity: We use real animal skeletons, ethically and sustainably sourced.

Artistry: Every creation is handcrafted with a meticulous eye for detail.

Exclusivity: No two pieces are the same, making each artwork a one-of-a-kind treasure.

Gothic Home Decor Appeal: Perfect for those who appreciate dark aesthetics and unconventional art.

Payment Terms:

We accept major credit cards, PayPal, and other secure payment methods.

Payments must be completed before processing orders.

Custom orders require a deposit before production.

Other Information:

Shipping available only to U.S

Strict policies against reselling in unauthorized markets.

Compliant with ethical sourcing and preservation guidelines.

For more details, visit our website or contact us directly.
